description: Work with your ClickFunnels 2.0 account: find, create, update and remove contacts, tag them and add notes, read orders, products, funnels, form submissions and courses, and manage webhook endpoints.

clickfunnels_form_submitted_trigger.description: Runs each time someone fills in a form on one of your ClickFunnels pages, such as an opt-in or an application, to follow up or save their answers. Gives you their email, name and phone number, and what they entered. Submissions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.contact_id: The ID of the contact who filled it in.
output.page_id: The ID of the page the form is on.

parameters.description: Choose the ClickFunnels workspace to watch, or leave it empty to use the one you connected.
parameters.name: workspace_id

clickfunnels_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in ClickFunnels, such as someone who opts in on a funnel page, to add them to your CRM or send a welcome. Gives you their email, name, phone number and tags. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and a contact added by an import starts it too. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.tags: The names of the contact's tags.

parameters.description: Choose the ClickFunnels workspace to watch, or leave it empty to use the one you connected.
parameters.name: workspace_id

clickfunnels_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in ClickFunnels, a one-time purchase or a subscription, such as to thank the buyer or log the sale. Gives you the order number, the buyer's email and name, the total, whether it is paid, and the funnel it came from. Test orders don't start it, nor do orders already there when the workflow is turned on. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.billing_status: Whether it is paid, such as paid or unpaid.
output.currency: The currency code, such as USD.
output.funnel_name: The funnel the order came from.
output.page_name: The page the order was placed on.

parameters.description: Choose the ClickFunnels workspace to watch, or leave it empty to use the one you connected.
parameters.name: workspace_id
